title: Leo Sprinkle finds Benowitz armed and saying 'they're coming'
place_text: Benowitz home, Four Hills, Albuquerque, New Mexico

tellings.quote: he said Bennis was there with like a like a rifle and a pistol and he said, you know, they're coming. You have to come in the house right now.

plain: Sometime around 1977 to 1980, a researcher named Leo Sprinkle visited the Albuquerque home of a man named Paul Bennewitz and found him holding a rifle and a pistol, saying "they're coming" and telling Sprinkle to get into the house right away. The writer Greg Bishop tells this, passing on what Sprinkle told him. It is told to show how far Bennewitz's fear of visitors had gone.
